title: Heather McPhee settles all claims in lawsuit against NFLPA and others

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Heather McPhee settles all claims in lawsuit against NFLPA and others
sources.description: Earlier this summer, former NFL Players Association general counsel Heather McPhee settled her wrongful discharge lawsuit against the union, without resolving the pending claims against the other defendants in the lawsuit.
